name: Prince Alwaleed bin Talal
detail: First Saudi signatory to The Giving Pledge (2016), pledging his fortune to philanthropy; private charitable giving, not statutory wealth taxation.

name: G20 Ministerial Declaration Signatories (Rio, 2024)
detail: Saudi delegation agreed to general G20 Rio tax cooperation language on effective taxation of ultra-high-net-worth individuals, without endorsing a net wealth tax.

name: Mohammed bin Salman Al Saud
detail: Crown Prince and Prime Minister who explicitly ruled out introducing personal income taxation or wealth taxation in his televised 2021 Vision 2030 interview.

name: White Land Tax (رسوم الأراضي البيضاء)
detail: Annual 2.5% fee on vacant urban land plots to encourage housing development; a land/property tax excluded under Section 2.

name: Zakat Regulations (ZATCA)
detail: Statutory 2.5% Islamic levy on business capital and working assets of Saudi and GCC nationals and companies; religious jurisprudential duty governed by Sharia principles.

name: Dr. Ihsan Bu-Hulaiga
detail: Prominent Saudi economist who analyzed California billionaire tax and European wealth taxes in Maaal, highlighting valuation and capital mobility challenges without endorsing a wealth tax.
